_metadata.description: Parameterized routing-table template covering models, jobs, and fallback chains. Drop in your provider keys and job names. Prices are list prices read 2026-09-25; refresh them against vendor pricing pages before relying on them.
notes: Every cost_per_1m_input_usd / cost_per_1m_output_usd value is a list price read 2026-09-25. Verify before trusting.
expected_cost_per_call_usd is computed from the listed token assumptions, not measured. Replace with real averages from your trace logs once you have them.
Open-weights provider pricing churns more than frontier API pricing. Check quarterly at minimum.
Self-hosted entries set per-token cost to 0 by convention; real cost is capex plus power and is tracked separately.

gpt-frontier.name: gpt-6-astra
gpt-frontier._note: Short-context price; long-context requests bill at $20 / $75.

deepseek-open-mid.name: deepseek-flash
deepseek-open-mid._note: Off-peak price; doubles 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays. DeepSeek's privacy policy says data is stored in China: set privacy_class accordingly. The MIT-licensed weights also run on other hosts.

open-code-hosted.name: mimo-v2.6-pro
open-code-hosted._note: Top open-weights model on the Artificial Analysis index on 2026-09-25 (MIT license). Price as listed there; confirm with your host.

qwen-local.name: qwen3.8:27b
qwen-local.verify_pricing_url: n/a: local hardware; capex plus power tracked separately
qwen-local._note: Needs about 18 GB free memory (32 GB machine). Thinking is on by default; read the model card for the per-mode sampler settings.

anthropic_then_open.description: Try Anthropic primary, fall back to a hosted open-weights model on rate-limit or 5xx. Check the fallback's privacy class before routing private data to it.

frontier_quality_chain.description: For jobs where quality matters most. Primary frontier model, secondary cross-vendor frontier, no degraded text fallback.

code_chain.description: Code generation chain. Local Qwen3.8 27B primary; hosted open-weights model secondary; Sonnet last.

low_latency_chain.description: Latency-sensitive chain. GPT-6 Luna primary, Claude Haiku secondary.

raise_immediately.description: No fallback. Job refuses to degrade. Caller decides what to do.

ticket_classification.description: Inbound support ticket classification into a fixed taxonomy.
ticket_classification._cost_note: 0.0018 = (800/1M)*1.00 + (200/1M)*5.00. List price read 2026-09-25 for claude-haiku-4-5; verify before relying on it.

conversation_summarization.description: Summarize a multi-turn conversation transcript for human review.
conversation_summarization._cost_note: 0.0100 = (3000/1M)*2.00 + (400/1M)*10.00. List price read 2026-09-25 for claude-sonnet-5; verify before relying on it.
conversation_summarization._temperature_note: No temperature: claude-sonnet-5 rejects sampling params. Steer with output_config effort.
conversation_summarization._max_tokens_note: Thinking counts toward max_tokens on this model, so the cap is well above the expected answer length.
